headlines.title_en: The 2026 Financial Street Forum Annual Meeting will open in Beijing on October 19
headlines.summary_en: Approved by the State Council, the 2026 Financial Street Forum Annual Meeting, co-hosted by the Beijing Municipal People's Government together with the People's Bank of China, the National Financial Regulatory Administration, the China Securities Regulatory Commission, Xinhua News Agency, and the State Administration of Foreign Exchange, is scheduled to be held in Beijing Financial Street from October 19 to 22. This year's annual meeting will take "Openness, Cooperation, Inclusiveness—Building a New Ecosystem for Global Financial Development Together" as its theme, inviting important guests from domestic and international economic and financial fields to discuss and exchange views, deepen practical international financial cooperation, build consensus on global financial development, and inject lasting financial strength into promoting the construction of an open and win-win global financial system. It is reported that the forum will invite about 400 speakers from more than 40 countries and regions around the world, including representatives from international economic and financial organizations, government departments of multiple countries, well-known Chinese and foreign financial institutions, central state-owned enterprises, multinational enterprises, and private enterprises. (Xinhua News Agency

headlines.summary: 国务院国资委党委书记、主任程福波在《新型工业化》刊发署名文章表示，积极培育壮大战略性新兴产业。新兴产业和未来产业是引领现代化产业体系建设的关键力量。当前中央企业新兴产业和未来产业布局还需提质加速，一些产业尚未形成竞争优势，必须在打造新兴支柱产业上下更大功夫，按照“领跑一批、赶超一批、培育一批”的思路，统筹推进差异化布局，持续巩固新能源、航空航天等产业优势，进一步发力人工智能、新材料等重点领域，超前培育量子科技、核聚变能、生物制造等前沿赛道，推动新兴产业发展“积厚成势”。

headlines.title_en: SASAC of the State Council: Further step up efforts in key areas such as AI and new materials, and cultivate frontier tracks such as quantum technology ahead of time
headlines.summary_en: Cheng Fubo, Party Secretary and Director of the State-owned Assets Supervision and Administration Commission of the State Council, published a signed article in "New Industrialization" stating that the country will actively cultivate and strengthen strategic emerging industries. Emerging and future industries are key forces leading the construction of a modern industrial system. At present, the layout of central enterprises in emerging and future industries still needs to improve in quality and accelerate, and some industries have yet to form competitive advantages. Greater efforts must be made in building new pillar industries. Following the approach of "leading a group, catching up with a group, and cultivating a group," the country will coordinate differentiated layouts, continue to consolidate advantages in industries such as new energy and aerospace, further focus on key areas such as artificial intelligence and new materials, and cultivate frontier tracks such as quantum technology, nuclear fusion energy, and biomanufacturing in advance, promoting the development of emerging industries to "accumulate strength and gain momentum."

headlines.title: 交通运输部等四部门：结合实施大规模设备更新政策，支持新能源公交车及动力电池更新
headlines.summary: 交通运输部、国家发展改革委、财政部、人力资源社会保障部发布《关于促进城市公交企业深化改革的指导意见》，其中提出，严格落实政府补贴补偿制度。贯彻落实《城市公共交通条例》相关规定，落实市县级财政支出责任，根据城市公共交通实际和财政承受能力安排城市公共交通发展所需经费并纳入本级预算。城市人民政府要在公交企业营收达不到年度预期目标时，按规定做好政策支持，采取措施保障公交线路正常运行。

headlines.title_en: Ministry of Transport and three other departments: In conjunction with implementing the large-scale equipment renewal policy, support the renewal of new energy buses and power batteries
headlines.summary_en: The Ministry of Transport, the National Development and Reform Commission, the Ministry of Finance, and the Ministry of Human Resources and Social Security issued the Guiding Opinions on Promoting the Deepening Reform of Urban Public Transport Enterprises, which proposes strictly implementing the government subsidy and compensation system. The relevant provisions of the Regulations on Urban Public Transport shall be implemented, municipal and county-level fiscal expenditure responsibilities shall be fulfilled, and funds needed for urban public transport development shall be arranged according to the actual situation of urban public transport and fiscal affordability and included in the corresponding level's budget. When the revenue of public transport enterprises falls short of the annual expected target, urban people's governments shall provide policy support in accordance with regulations and take measures to ensure the normal operation of public transport routes.

headlines.title_en: Lan Fo'an attends the 11th Annual Meeting of the Board of Governors of the Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank via video link
headlines.summary_en: From September 28 to 29, the 11th Annual Meeting of the Board of Governors of the Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank was held in Doha, Qatar. The theme of this annual meeting was "Infrastructure for the Future: Impact and Innovation." Representatives of member countries discussed topics including the AIIB increasing infrastructure investment and financing, further enhancing development benefits and efficiency, and better helping members address challenges. Lan Fo'an, China's Governor at the AIIB and Minister of Finance, attended the annual meeting by video and delivered remarks. Lan Fo'an pointed out that with the support of all members, the AIIB has smoothly achieved a stable management transition and embarked on a new journey of development. In the face of a turbulent and intertwined international situation and a growing development deficit, the AIIB should remain unwavering in upholding multilateralism and handle everyone's affairs through consultation; remain unwavering in its original aspiration and mission and persistently advance the implementation of the institution's strategic priorities; and remain unwavering in high-standard operations and focus on improving project quality and development benefits.

headlines.title: 国务院国资委： “十五五”时期将继续做好新央企组建和战略性重组
headlines.summary: 国务院国资委党委书记、主任程福波在《新型工业化》刊发署名文章《更好发挥国资央企排头兵作用 为现代化产业体系建设贡献更大力量》。“十五五”时期，将继续用好战略性专业化重组整合这个有力抓手，做好新央企组建和战略性重组，支持创新能力强的企业作为主体，开展同类业务横向整合和上下游纵向整合，加快推动国有资本向关系国家安全、国民经济命脉的重要行业和关键领域集中，向关系国计民生的公共服务、应急能力、公益性领域等集中，向前瞻性战略性新兴产业集中。

headlines.title_en: SASAC: During the 15th Five-Year Plan period, it will continue to advance the establishment of new central SOEs and strategic restructuring
headlines.summary_en: Cheng Fubo, Party Secretary and Director of the State-owned Assets Supervision and Administration Commission of the State Council, published a signed article in "New Industrialization" titled "Better Play the Vanguard Role of State-owned Assets and Central Enterprises and Contribute More to the Construction of a Modern Industrial System." During the "15th Five-Year Plan" period, the country will continue to make good use of strategic and specialized restructuring and integration as a powerful lever, do a good job in establishing new central enterprises and strategic restructuring, support enterprises with strong innovation capabilities as the main entities, carry out horizontal integration of similar businesses and vertical integration of upstream and downstream operations, and accelerate the concentration of state-owned capital in important industries and key areas related to national security and the lifelines of the national economy, in public services, emergency response capabilities, and public welfare areas related to the national economy and people's livelihood, and in forward-looking strategic emerging industries.

headlines.title_en: US stocks open mixed across three major indices
headlines.summary_en: The three major U.S. stock indexes closed mixed, with the S&P 500 up 0.12%, the Dow down 0.09%, and the Nasdaq up 0.32%. Among large technology stocks, Advanced Micro Devices rose 1.28%, Meta rose 1.15%, and SpaceX rose 1.05%. Among Chinese concept stocks, JD.com fell 1.11%, Bilibili fell 1.32%, Trip.com fell 2.23%, XPeng Group fell 3.32%, Li Auto fell 3.33%, and NIO fell 4.32%.

headlines.title: *ST禾信：发行股份及支付现金购买56.00%股权获审核通过
headlines.summary: *ST禾信公告，公司此前拟通过发行股份及支付现金方式购买吴明、上海堰岛企业管理合伙企业（有限合伙）等两名交易对方合计持有的上海量羲技术有限公司56.00%股权并募集配套资金暨关联交易。2026年9月29日，上交所重组委审议结果为本次交易符合重组条件和信息披露要求；本次交易尚需经中国证券监督管理委员会同意注册后方可实施。

headlines.title_en: *ST Hexin: issuance of shares and cash payment to acquire 56.00% equity approved in review
headlines.summary_en: *ST Hexin announced that the company had previously planned to purchase, by issuing shares and paying cash, 56.00% equity in Shanghai Liangxi Technology Co., Ltd. held collectively by two counterparties, Wu Ming and Shanghai Yandao Enterprise Management Partnership (Limited Partnership), and to raise matching funds, constituting a related-party transaction. On September 29, 2026, the review result of the Shanghai Stock Exchange M&A Review Committee was that this transaction complies with restructuring conditions and information disclosure requirements; this transaction still needs to be registered with the approval of the China Securities Regulatory Commission before it can be implemented.
